title: LinkyC2's Custom Sound Pack
description: This Project adds custom sounds for LinkyC2's Resource Pack to go along with the mobs
body:
This resource Pack adds Custom sounds for mobs in the game. Currently only the chicken sound is in the game but I am planning to add more. These sounds are going to be custom for most mobs.

# Installation Guide
![Installation Guide](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8c5148d4ee1376b812a4660770005c32d028b9d2.png)

Download the Pack

![Open the Resource Pack menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/aff96c7d73d2cb8e929d6d34cd8ef5f75c3f2131.png)

Go to options > resource packs

![Drag and drop it into minecraft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d77f11ef5411c91524fa122540a02fc1447ad141.png)

Drag and drop it into minecraft
